coverage.note: 复核 Federal Reserve 9 月 15–16 日 minutes、BLS 2026 日程与 CPI 日程、FTMO Trading Updates archive；只将可公开核验的日期和数字作为事实。
Reuters 10 月 7 日发布后报道独立核验 minutes 讨论与已发布状态；没有保留新的、可验证的事件专属非方向性计算需求。
公开 Reddit 时间戳与市场日历帖子显示 FOMC 注意力，但分别是回测数据卫生和方向/催化剂语境，未形成可归属的 fixed-risk、pip/tick value、margin、quantity、cost 或 portfolio-risk 问题。ForexFactory、BabyPips 未保留合格事件专属信号。
公开可验证索引未出现可保留的当期非方向性计算需求；动态、登录墙、截图和不可稳定复核材料均不计入证据。

independently reports post-release minutes discussion of preparing for Treasury-market stress

decision.reopen_trigger: An independently verifiable new fact or correction plus a public English query explicitly tying that fact to a non-directional pip-value, fixed-risk, margin, cost, quantity or portfolio-heat calculation. Any qualified work must refresh an existing FOMC article rather than create a generic duplicate.
decision.rationale: The published minutes and Reuters report create a real factual delta, but retained public material remains policy/yield/FX direction or backtest-timestamp discussion. No natural retail search-to-existing-calculator journey, replacement teaching number, or non-directional calculation request was verified. The calculator-fit hard gate therefore fails; no playbook or package is allowed.
